newsitem.title: USA: Diedrich moves higher in market debut.
newsitem.headline: Diedrich moves higher in market debut.

text.p: Diedrich Coffee Inc shares moved higher in their market debut on Thursday after the stock was priced below its estimated range for the initial public offering.
The shares moved up one point to 10-1/2 and touched a high of 12 during the trading session. They priced at $9.50 each, below an estimated range of $10.50 to $11.50.
Of the 2.2 million shares in the IPO, 1.6 million were offered by the company and 600,000 by stockholders.
Net proceeds will be used to pay back debt, fund coffeehouse expansion, for infrastructure enhancements and for working capital, the company said.
After the offering, the company will have about 5,391,650 shares outstanding. The Boston Group was the lead underwriter of the offering.
Diedrich Coffee operates 37 coffeehouses in Southern California, Colorado and Texas.
